_note: Falsifiable design hypotheses for the seeded VEGF-A run. Each states what result would kill it. In live mode Claude re-words the statement and updates posterior confidence from the gate outcomes; the falsification criteria and planned tests stay under the engine's control so the model cannot quietly move the goalposts.

items.statement: A VHH binder directed at the VEGF-A receptor-binding pole will block VEGFR-2 engagement while remaining developable as a single domain.
falsification_criteria: Fewer than one candidate clears the binding and independent-structure gates together.
Every candidate that clears binding carries two or more developability liabilities, indicating the epitope forces an undevelopable paratope.
The independent structure model places the paratope away from the receptor-binding pole for all survivors.
supporting_evidence_claims: The VEGFR-binding determinants sit at the two poles
A neutralising antibody Fab has been co-crystallised
planned_tests: Gate 1: predicted interface confidence against the selected epitope
Gate 2: independent structure agreement from a different model family

items.statement: Candidates that pass the design model's own binding gate will disagree with an independent structure predictor at a rate high enough to justify the second gate.
falsification_criteria: Zero candidates are rejected at the independent-structure gate, which would mean the gate adds no information over the design path.
Primary and independent model agreement exceeds 0.9 for every candidate.
supporting_evidence_claims: Public co-structures of VEGF-A with both a receptor domain
planned_tests: Ablation: re-rank with the independent-structure gate removed

items.statement: Adversarial challenge (alanine scan plus decoy antigens) will reject at least one candidate that passed all three prior gates, because high predicted affinity alone does not imply epitope-specific binding.
falsification_criteria: Every candidate that reaches the challenge survives it.
Decoy discrimination margin exceeds the threshold for all candidates, meaning the decoy panel is not discriminating.
planned_tests: Gate 4: alanine scan across epitope-contact positions
Ablation: re-rank with the adversarial gate removed

items.statement: A candidate rejected only for a hydrophobic-patch developability liability can be rescued by polar substitution at the CDR3 apex without losing the predicted interface.
falsification_criteria: The redesign drops below the binding-gate threshold.
The redesign fails to reduce the aggregation-propensity heuristic.
The redesign improves every metric simultaneously, which would indicate the model is not being scored honestly.
supporting_evidence_claims: The VEGF-A monomer carries an intrachain cystine knot
contradicting_evidence_claims: No experimental binding, expression, or stability data exists
planned_tests: Redesign the selected near-miss and re-run all four gates
Compare parent and child on every stored raw metric
